items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 84:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the MAN of the Nukva face to face? The MAN of the Nukva at the time that she is face to face are from the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of ZA, drawn from the Mazal. As above in Answer 7. (Item 138).
